summary: Project details wireless charging of vechile
details: Wireless charging of electric vehicles is a modern technology used to charge electric vehicle batteries without connecting a charging cable. It works on the principle of Electromagnetic Induction. In this technology, electrical energy is transferred from a charging pad on the ground to a receiver coil fitted underneath the vehicle.
